# Issue 1099 — Advanced Search: "Generated by TestLink on …" results footer restored

The modern **Advanced Search** screen
(`gui/templates/search/searchAdvancedView.html`) closed a result set with the
match count only (`#footerInfo`). The legacy results page closed it with a
**"Generated by TestLink on `<date>`"** stamp below the results tables. The
stamp is back — rendered server-side in the TestLink session-locale format.

## Legacy behaviour (1.9.20)

`gui/templates/dashio/search/searchResults.tpl:33-39`

```smarty
{if !isset($gui->warning_msg) || $gui->warning_msg == ''}
  {foreach from=$gui->tableSet key=idx item=matrix}
    {$tableID="table_$idx"}
    {$matrix->renderBodySection($tableID)}
  {/foreach}
  <br />
  {lang_get s='generated_by_TestLink_on'} {$smarty.now|date_format:$gsmarty_timestamp_format}
{else}
  <div class="user_feedback"><br />{$gui->warning_msg}</div>
{/if}
```

* `generated_by_TestLink_on` — "Generated by TestLink on" + the render time,
  formatted by Smarty with `$gsmarty_timestamp_format`, which
  `lib/functions/tlsmarty.inc.php:304` assigns from
  `$tlCfg->locales_timestamp_format[$session locale]` (`cfg/const.inc.php:303`),
  i.e. **the logged-in user's language**, not the browser locale.
* The stamp sits inside the `no warning` guard, so a `no_records_found` or
  `empty_testproject` search showed the feedback box and **no** stamp.

## The gap (modern screen)

`gui/templates/search/searchAdvancedView.html` `renderResults()` wrote only
the match count:

```js
$('#footerInfo').text(!r.warning && total > 0 ? TLi18n.t('search.matchCount', {n: total}) : '');
```

Measured baseline before the fix (browser DOM probe, search `alpha` on fixture
project 1): `{ footer: "2 matches", matchCount: "(2 matches)", rows: 3 }` — no
date anywhere. Screenshot:
`docs/screenshots/issue-1099-search-footer-before.png`.

## Modern re-implementation

* **BFF** `api/search/index.php`, `action=fulltext` (index.php:637-661) — the
  payload now carries the stamp:

  | field | meaning |
  |---|---|
  | `generated_on` | already localized with the session language format (`tlStrftime($tsFormat, time())`) |
  | `generated_on_iso` | `Y-m-d H:i:s`, used as the stamp tooltip |

  The format resolution (session locale → `locales_timestamp_format[locale]` →
  `timestamp_format` fallback) is the exact same block the sibling
  `action=search` already had for Issue #1093 (index.php:414-430) — a browser
  `Date().toLocaleString()` cannot honour the TestLink locale formats, which is
  why the BFF renders it server-side (same rationale as
  `api/requirements/index.php` for Issue #1081).

* **Screen** `gui/templates/search/searchAdvancedView.html`
  * new footer block `#footerGenerated` (hidden until a result set exists) with
    `#footerGenOn` (the stamp), placed right after the match-count footer
    `#footerInfo` and before the static "TestLink 2.0.1 - Advanced Search"
    footer — mirroring legacy order (results → stamp → page footer);
  * `renderGeneratedFooter(r)` runs inside `renderResults()` and returns
    early — leaving the block hidden — when the search produced a warning, no
    rows, or no `generated_on`, reproducing the legacy `{if !warning_msg}`
    guard;
  * `resetForm()` hides the block and clears `#footerGenOn` text + `title`, so
    a timestamp can never describe a result set that is no longer on screen;
  * `#footerInfo` keeps the match count untouched (regression-checked).

* **i18n** — **no bundle was changed**: the label reuses the already
  translated `common.generatedBy` (= legacy
  `generated_by_TestLink_on`, "Generated by TestLink on" in `en.json:762`,
  present in all 10 bundles; coverage gate `verify_i18n_coverage.sh` PASS).

## Behaviour notes

* The stamp format follows the **session** language (legacy semantics); the
  label follows the client-side locale bundle — the same split legacy had
  between the server-rendered timestamp and the language strings.
* The stamp is refreshed on every render, so a re-run of the same search shows
  the new time.
* Reset / no-match searches never show a stamp (legacy guard parity).

`tmp/TLU_Test_Cases.md`, suite **"Task — Issue #1099"** (10 cases, all PASS):
gap baseline, stamp render, BFF `generated_on` payload, Reset, no-match
warning, stamp refresh, console, syntax gates, i18n coverage gate, Event

## Fixtures

* `/tmp/opencode/fixture_1099.sql` — project 1 "Demo Project" (prefix DEMO),
  suite 2 "Suite Alpha", test case 3 "Alpha login smoke test" (tcversion node
  4). The run started from a zero-project database (fresh import), so the
  fixture was created with direct SQL.
* Gotcha: `testprojects.api_key` is `UNI` with a **constant** DEFAULT — always
  provide an explicit unique `api_key` in a fixture INSERT (documented in
  Issue #1081).
